Name: Sakura Mochi Bus
Author: cozysweetpotato
Description:
Recolors the bus to be cutesy and flowery. I am using the lovely faedew reshade in my screenshots. Content Patcher and SMAPI required.

This is my first mod. I hope someone likes it. I just started pixel art for the first time 3 days ago. I plan to make more mods esp another bus because I don't really like how this one turned out. I want to make COTTAGEVALLEY someday so stick around for that. I am also working on NPCs (I have Haley half done).

If there are any issues that occur please let me know. If you have any color requests for a bus also let me know and I will try to make it happen. 

Thank you so much for your support ♡
